title: MergeQueueParkedPrStateMachine
description: State-machine spec for the merge-queue parked-PR + fix-loop integration shipped by M-CC-P10-IP-006. Companion to the kernel modules parked_state, pr_retry_budget, speculative_rebase, fairness, scheduler in crates/oya-foundry-vcs-review-mergequeue-kernel.

_meta.purpose: Canonical state-machine spec for parked-PR semantics + bounded retry + fairness + speculative rebase. Companion to the kernel scheduler in oya-foundry-vcs-review-mergequeue-kernel.

transitions.note: Initial admission via IP-004 pr-review-approved event.
Queue position preserved; other admissible PRs continue processing.

transitions.trigger: fix-loop-converged (new head sha on PR branch)
transitions.note: Triggers speculative rebase against CURRENT queue head (which may have advanced).
Per-PR retry counter increments by 1 (one cycle = one increment regardless of how many failed jobs).
Stays parked; fix-loop must produce a fresh tip that resolves the conflict.
Head advances; per-PR retry counter cleared.

invariants.queue_position_preservation: A parked PR retains its admission_position; it is skipped on each tick but not removed.
invariants.fairness: While one PR is parked, other admissible PRs continue processing. Parked PRs do NOT block head.
invariants.shared_retry_budget: Per-PR retry budget is N=5 attempts; mirrors the shared-pool budget in IP-005 (the integration crate deduplicates the escalation issue by PR number, so a PR can never receive two stuck-PR issues for the same exhaustion).
invariants.convergence_proof: Every scheduler tick appends a TickEntry to registry/merge-queue-tick-log.json so an external observer can verify forward progress and detect deadlock/livelock.
invariants.no_agent_owned_rebase: Inherits ADR-0083 / kernel invariant: agents NEVER own rebase/merge operations; the scheduler is controller-owned.

concurrent_fix_loops.convergence: Multiple parked PRs may have fix-loop agents running in parallel. The scheduler serializes ONLY the final landing (one PR merges per tick); other parked PRs stay parked. Concurrent fix-loops do NOT deadlock — proof: see test `concurrent_fix_loops_converge_one_merges_other_re_parks` in scheduler.rs.
